title: Benedikte Brechmann, Design System
description: I independently created a design system for a group-developed web application, documenting its visual styles, components, interaction patterns, and design guidelines. Using the team's HTML, CSS, and JavaScript as the primary reference, I organised the existing interface into a structured Figma document to establish a clear overview of the implemented design.

title: Benedikte Brechmann, Frontend Development & UX Improvements
description: I independently developed and delivered the homepage of a group-developed web application for Benedikte Brechmann, focusing particularly on implementing an interactive carousel using JavaScript. Following the initial development, I conducted user testing, identified usability issues, and designed improvements to the homepage and other key interfaces. I presented these improvements as an interactive Figma prototype during my final examination.

title: REFILLD, Instagram Advertisement
description: I independently designed an Instagram advertisement for REFILLD as part of a collaborative content workshop. Targeting women aged 23–29, I selected product imagery, typography, colours, and layout to create a playful, minimalist composition. Using a question about hot and iced coffee, I developed a visually engaging concept that communicates the product's versatility while appealing to the intended audience.

title: Word Festival, Personalised Programme Flyer
description: I independently designed a personalised festival programme flyer for Word Festival as part of a collaborative project. I was responsible for the entire visual design, including layout, typography, and the organisation of speaker information and schedules. Working within the festival's visual identity, I created a printed programme that helps visitors navigate their selected events and plan their festival experience.

title: Word Festival, Poster Redesign
description: I independently redesigned an existing promotional poster for Word Festival as part of an individual examination project. Using Figma, I improved the typography, readability, visual hierarchy, and overall composition while maintaining the festival's established visual identity. The redesign presents the personalised programme more prominently and communicates its purpose through a clearer, more focused layout.

title: Christmas Card, Image Retouching
description: I edited a personalised Christmas card image for a private client in Adobe Photoshop. The original artwork featured painted footprints from her two sons, but the print included distracting smudges and lacked colour intensity. I refined the composition by removing unwanted marks and enhancing the colours, then adjusted the result further based on client feedback to create a clearer and more visually striking final image.
